- You can easily choose the parking lot that matches your criteria and parking needs.
- With Indigo Neo, there's no need to go to the parking meter: pay directly with your smartphone when parking on the street, your receipt is in the app. You can extend or stop your parking remotely.
- You can add several vehicles to your account (family car, company car, children's car...). You can easily manage your parking bills or expense reports from your purchase history.
- Indigo Neo also accepts the Total Card: add it from "My account" in the "Cards" section.
- Finally, you can manage all your parking needs from one application!
 
Indigo Neo – The app for city parking is available in many cities and continues to roll out everywhere!
